title: Microsoft Teams: real-time call queue metrics in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The briefing passes with gaps: the current Microsoft documentation supports the licensing requirements, existing controls and permission-based access. The categorical read-only claim is not documented; rollout wording, the shortened policy path and the policy-value terminology need minor corrections.
